name: Verdemar
source:
The royal sorceress Soledad has trapped the crown princess and her surly erstwhile lover—a knight returning from her noble crusade along the coast—inside a locked bedroom inside the palace. With only hours before the royal banquet, will the princess and her knight be able to stop their squabbling for long enough to find a way out? Or will they be doomed to its beige walls and cozy but nondescript furnishings forever?

Perhaps a miracle will be needed to help them escape… or at least a little self-awareness.
